# Foundation Requirements Checklist: Pipeline Foundation

**Purpose**: Validate that the Pipeline Foundation requirements and design artifacts are clear, complete, consistent, and ready for task generation.  
**Created**: 2026-06-10  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all user-visible foundation behaviours covered by requirements, including config loading, path derivation, overrides, run records, partial-run handling, and tool validation? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [x] CHK002 Are all explicitly excluded heavy stages documented consistently so task generation cannot accidentally include reconstruction, matching, undistortion, patching, training, cleanup, compression, or merge work? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK003 Are the required non-duplicative run-record artifacts named in both requirements and contracts, including effective config, CLI overrides, manifest, status, timings, and logs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Run Record]
- [x] CHK004 Are public-safe config requirements documented for both the spec and example config contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Contract §Config]
- [x] CHK005 Are external tool validation requirements complete for COLMAP, LichtFeld Studio, and conditional SOG conversion checks? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012..FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the meaning of `project.dir` clear as the dataset/project root from which normal paths are derived? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002..FR-003]
- [x] CHK007 Is `project.recolour_images` defined clearly enough to distinguish validation of recoloured images from later SfM/undistortion behaviour? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §PipelineConfig]
- [x] CHK008 Are dotted CLI override requirements clear about accepted keys, invalid keys, and where accepted overrides are recorded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009..FR-010, Contract §CLI]
- [x] CHK009 Is the partial-run decision language precise enough to distinguish resume/continue from start-over/overwrite? [Clarity, Spec §US3, Contract §Partial Run Decisions]
- [x] CHK010 Are target external tool versions specified clearly without implying that Feature 1 runs heavy external processing? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do the spec, plan, data model, and contracts use the same canonical names for Pipeline Config, Effective Config, CLI Override, Run Record, Partial Run, and Tool Validation Result? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, Data Model]
- [x] CHK012 Are config path derivation rules consistent across the spec, data model, config schema contract, and quickstart? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §ProjectDirectory, Contract §Config]
- [x] CHK013 Are non-interactive partial-run requirements consistent between the clarification entry, acceptance scenario, functional requirement, and CLI contract? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-021, Contract §CLI]
- [x] CHK014 Are config-difference requirements consistent between the clarification entry, success criteria, data model, and run-record contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018/FR-022, Contract §Config Diff Event]
- [x] CHK015 Are public-path/privacy requirements consistent with the constitution's data safety principle? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Constitution §VI]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Are acceptance scenarios independently testable for each user story without relying on later SfM or splatting features? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [x] CHK017 Are success criteria measurable enough to support a future `speckit-analyze` pass and implementation tasks? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK018 Does each priority story include an independent test statement that matches the feature boundary? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [x] CHK019 Are failure outcomes specified for invalid configs, missing folders, unsupported tools, unknown overrides, and missing non-interactive decisions? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are primary, alternate, exception, and recovery flows all represented in the requirements? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [x] CHK021 Are single-camera and multi-camera dataset layout requirements both addressed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006..FR-007]
- [x] CHK022 Are recoloured-image layout requirements covered only when recolouring is enabled? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK023 Are partial-run recovery flows covered for both interactive and non-interactive contexts? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK024 Are future-stage placeholders such as SOG validation bounded so they do not expand Feature 1 scope accidentally? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014..FR-015]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are ambiguous `raw_images/` layouts defined as invalid rather than left to implementation judgement? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 Are corrupt or incomplete previous run records addressed as partial/uncertain runs requiring user attention? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §PartialRun]
- [x] CHK027 Are existing run directory collisions covered by requirements or contracts before task generation? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK028 Are unsupported external tool versions covered as early failures before heavy work begins? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-013]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK029 Are observability requirements specific about which records capture timings, warnings, status, tool versions, and decisions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011..FR-012, Contract §Run Record]
- [x] CHK030 Are reproducibility requirements specific about source config, effective config, and CLI override persistence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Run Record]
- [x] CHK031 Are data safety requirements sufficient to prevent mutation of raw images and leakage of private paths in public configs? [Coverage, Constitution §VI, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK032 Are performance expectations for foundation checks bounded without becoming implementation tests? [Measurability, Plan §Technical Context]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK033 Are external dependencies and target versions documented in both assumptions and planning context? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK034 Are old-repo references clearly framed as evidence rather than requirements to copy? [Assumption, Plan §Summary, Research]
- [x] CHK035 Are deferred details, such as exact implementation flag names for resume/overwrite decisions, placed in contracts or plan rather than left ambiguous in the spec? [Traceability, Contract §CLI]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK036 Is there any remaining conflict between "all normal paths are derived" and the advanced path overrides described in the config schema contract? [Conflict, Contract §Config]
- [x] CHK037 Is the phrase "future advanced sections may exist but are not executed" sufficiently bounded to prevent tasks from implementing later SfM/splat features? [Ambiguity, Data Model §PipelineConfig]
- [x] CHK038 Are terms such as "foundation check", "preflight", "run record", and "partial run" used consistently across all artifacts? [Ambiguity, Spec/Data Model/Contracts]
- [x] CHK039 Are all checklist-relevant requirements traceable to a spec requirement, data model entity, or contract section? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Use this checklist before `/speckit-tasks`.
- Items should be checked against the requirements and design documents, not against implementation behaviour.
